A few quick answers to get you started. You can find these later in Settings.
What do the cloud icons mean?

A green cloud means the photo is backed up to Proton Drive and still on this device. A white cloud means it is only in Proton Drive, not on this device. No icon means it is only on this device and not backed up yet.
New photos and videos back up automatically once backup is on. You can keep backups to Wi-Fi only in Settings, so they pause on mobile data.
What are albums, and what does folder mirroring do?
Albums group photos on Proton Drive. \"Mirror device folders as Drive albums\" makes your phone folders, like Camera or Screenshots, appear as matching albums on Drive as they back up.
What does \"Mirror changes to local files\" do?

When the app strips metadata or renames a photo as it backs it up, it applies those same changes to the original on your phone too, so the local file and the backed-up copy stay identical. It applies only to photos this app backs up, going forward, and does not pull edits you make on Proton Drive web back to your phone.
Does the app change my existing photos?

No. Metadata changes happen only when the app backs up a photo, and only if you turn on metadata stripping or local mirroring. Photos already on your phone are left as they are unless you choose a per-photo action.
